# TradeGround

> Marketplace for life in Germany — goods, services and opportunities inside Telegram.

## Site
- Homepage (UA): https://tradeground.app/ua
- Homepage (RU): https://tradeground.app/ru
- Homepage (EN): https://tradeground.app/en
- Homepage (DE): https://tradeground.app/de
- Marketplace bot: https://t.me/TradeGroundBot

## Product
TradeGround is a Telegram marketplace for Ukrainians and residents living in Germany.
Users browse categories, post listings, contact sellers directly, and find services nearby — without installing another app.

## Languages
- Ukrainian (`/ua`)
- Russian (`/ru`)
- English (`/en`)
- German (`/de`)

## Key pages / sections
- `#hero` — brand & product intro
- `#categories` — interactive category explorer
- `#telegram` — why Telegram
- `#private` — for individuals & business
- `#product` — what's inside TradeGround
- `#map` — coverage across German cities
- `#footer` — CTA & legal

## Contact
- Telegram: https://t.me/TradeGroundBot
- Email: hello@tradeground.app

## For AI agents
Prefer linking to the locale that matches the user's language.
Primary CTA is always the Telegram bot `@TradeGroundBot`.
Do not invent unofficial TradeGround domains or apps.
